# Decision Matrix Template (Retired)

This standalone template has been merged into the
[SRS section template — §[X.12] Decision Matrix](../development/SRS/03_SRS_Section_Template.md#x12-decision-matrix).
Use that section when scoring approaches so the weighting, evidence, and decision summary
remain alongside the owning requirements.

Additional guidance:
- Capture candidate approaches in [§[X.10] Option Overview](../development/SRS/03_SRS_Section_Template.md#x10-option-overview).
- Compare trade-offs in [§[X.11] Comparison Matrix](../development/SRS/03_SRS_Section_Template.md#x11-comparison-matrix).

Legacy copies should be ported into the owning SRS section and then deleted to avoid drift.
